scientific_integrity: Theorem proven with explicit projective base-point computation and exact Sylvester resultant; dependent on credited existing extremality of the Herglotz–Nevanlinna family. Independently audited: no.
scientific_limitations: Only nonconstant real rational one-variable Herglotz–Nevanlinna inputs. No global resolution of Knese conjecture; historical-priority uncertainty persists. Symbolic checks confirm finite polynomial identities but do not replace general proof.
title: Universal torus saturation of rational Nevanlinna extremals
